entries.name: YM3812 OPL2
entries.description: Yamaha FM synthesizer with nine two-operator channels, a rhythm mode and two timers, programmed through an address register and a data register.
entries.behaviour: A write to the address port selects a register and a write to the data port sets it. A read returns the status: bit 7 interrupt, bit 6 timer 1 overflow, bit 5 timer 2 overflow.

entries.name: YMF262 OPL3
entries.description: Yamaha FM synthesizer, the OPL2's successor: a second register bank, four outputs, four-operator channels and eight waveforms. OPL2 compatible until a mode bit enables the new features.
entries.behaviour: Register select and data ports as on the OPL2, plus a second address port that selects the 0x100 bank. Bit 0 of register 0x105 is the OPL3 mode bit, off by default; while it is off, 0x05 sent to that port reaches register 0x105 and any other value the register of that number in the first bank.
